description: This Java abstract class 'AbstractCache' provides methods to manage caching operations for widget-related data in the OFBiz framework, including retrieving, creating, and clearing caches.

classes.name: AbstractCache
classes.description: An abstract class that manages caching of widget data, providing methods to remove, clear, get cache names, and retrieve or create caches.

methods.name: AbstractCache
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache with a specified ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes cache entries associated with a specific widget name.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all caches that start with the cache name prefix.

methods.name: getCacheNamePrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix used for cache names related to widgets.

methods.name: getCacheName
methods.description: Constructs the full cache name for a specific widget.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves an existing cache for a widget.

methods.name: getOrCreateCache
methods.description: Retrieves an existing cache or creates a new one for a widget.
